source.title: Feralas Mission III: Defeat Dragonkin
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Oneiros. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 10 Frenzied Whelps and 3 Wyrmkin Berserkers in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at Oneiros and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
